comparison.objective: Unlock a reverse-turning lock and open its lid without breaking the key, versus setting and locking an opening stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-82 stabilizes a loose box while turning a key in the safe direction; the candidate counterholds an adjustment screw while tightening its jam nut with a second tool.
comparison.success_condition: PR-82 rewards clockwise key rotation and lid travel while penalizing shear, prying, or box motion; the candidate requires retained angle and repeated gripper cycles.
comparison.reason: Shared rotational manipulation and steadying are generic; reverse-direction discovery and damage avoidance are meaningfully different from adjustment-preserving locknut countertorque.
